sec-push.title: Push apart (also a starting point for the optimizer)

sec-rows.title: Ordered rows (also a starting point for the optimizer)

algorithm.tooltip:
How thumbnails are arranged. None of the algorithms use stacking order or focus.

Optimizer: searches for the best balance of thumbnail size, staying in place and keeping relations (Scoring tab). Slowest: from a few milliseconds up to a few tens with many windows, when windows have changed.

Push apart: starts where the windows are, pushes overlapping ones apart, then scales everything to fit. Fast.

Ordered rows: rows from top to bottom, left to right within a row. Fast.

Equal grid: like Cinnamon's own grid, each window shrunk to fit its cell, but in the cell nearest to where it really is. Fast.

use-cache.tooltip: Reuses the previous arrangement of a workspace when its windows and the settings haven't changed since, which keeps the views quick; the result is the same either way. Focusing other windows, changing the stacking order, or minimizing and restoring windows don't count as changes. Leave this on; switching it off is only useful for troubleshooting.

debug-log.tooltip: Writes information for troubleshooting to the log. View it in Looking Glass (Alt+F2, then lg) under Log.

margin.tooltip: Empty border kept around the edge of the screen.

fidelity.tooltip: 1 keeps true size ratios between windows; 0 gives every thumbnail the same area; values in between compress size differences.

max-scale.tooltip: Largest size of a thumbnail compared with its real window; 1 means real size.

centered.tooltip: When off, the arrangement is moved toward where the real windows are, as far as the screen allows.

fill.tooltip: Lets thumbnails grow into free space after layout. Uses space better but makes sizes less faithful.

max-growth.tooltip: The most a thumbnail may grow while filling gaps.

w-place.tooltip: Reward for thumbnails staying near their real window.

w-relations.tooltip: Reward for windows keeping how they sit relative to each other.

relations-method.tooltip: Order only cares whether windows swap sides; Direction compares the angles between windows and is stricter.

neighbor-focus.tooltip: How much more nearby windows matter than distant ones.

optimizer-effort.tooltip: How hard the optimizer works. More gives better layouts but takes longer, and the more windows there are, the longer it takes. If opening the views gets choppy, lower this.

push-strength.tooltip: How far each push moves an overlapping pair.

push-match-shape.tooltip: Bias pushes toward the screen's shape.

scale-enabled.tooltip: When off, Cinnamon arranges Show all windows itself.

expo-enabled.tooltip: When off, Cinnamon arranges the windows in Show all workspaces itself.

expo-algorithm.tooltip:
How windows are arranged inside each workspace. None of the algorithms use stacking order or focus.

Optimizer: searches for the best balance of thumbnail size, staying in place and keeping relations (Scoring tab). Slowest: from a few milliseconds up to a few tens with many windows, when windows have changed.

Push apart: starts where the windows are, pushes overlapping ones apart, then scales everything to fit. Fast.

Ordered rows: rows from top to bottom, left to right within a row. Fast.

Equal grid: like Cinnamon's own grid, each window shrunk to fit its cell, but in the cell nearest to where it really is. Fast. Makes even small windows reasonably big, which helps in the small previews.

expo-margin.tooltip: Empty border inside each workspace preview.

expo-gap.tooltip: Space between windows inside each workspace preview.

expo-fidelity.tooltip: 1 keeps true size ratios between windows; 0 gives every thumbnail the same area; values in between compress size differences. Lower values make small windows easier to see in the small previews.

expo-max-scale.tooltip: Largest size of a thumbnail compared with its real window; 1 means real size.

expo-centered.tooltip: When off, the arrangement is moved toward where the real windows are, as far as the preview allows.

expo-fill.tooltip: Lets thumbnails grow into free space after layout. Uses space better but makes sizes less faithful.

expo-max-growth.tooltip: The most a thumbnail may grow while filling gaps.

rows-count.tooltip: Automatic tries every possible number of rows and uses the one that gives the biggest thumbnails.
